mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = 3, -- 3: 탈퇴 PASSWORD_HASH = 'WITHDRAWN_USER', NAME = NULL, EMAIL = NULL, PHONE = NULL, PROFILE_URL = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}
UPDATE MEMBER SET LAST_LOGIN_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, FAILURE_CNT = 0 WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}
UPDATE MEMBER SET LAST_LOGIN_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, FAILURE_CNT = 0 WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{login_id}
mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_ID, m.ROLE_ID, r.ROLE_CODE AS authority, r.ROLE_NAME, m.LOGIN_ID, m.PASSWORD_HASH AS password, m.NAME, m.EMAIL, m.PHONE AS tel, m.PROFILE_URL AS profile_photo, m.STATUS AS enabled, m.FAILURE_CNT, m.LAST_LOGIN_AT AS last_login, TO_CHAR(m.BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, m.ZIP, m.ADDR1, m.ADDR2, m.RECEIVE_EMAIL, m.SNS_PROVIDER, m.SNS_ID, m.CREATED_AT, m.UPDATED_AT FROM MEMBER m INNER JOIN APP_ROLE r ON m.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE m.MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}

SELECT m.MEMBER_ID, m.ROLE_ID, r.ROLE_CODE AS authority, r.ROLE_NAME, m.LOGIN_ID, m.PASSWORD_HASH AS password, m.NAME, m.EMAIL, m.PHONE AS tel, m.PROFILE_URL AS profile_photo, m.STATUS AS enabled, m.FAILURE_CNT, m.LAST_LOGIN_AT AS last_login, TO_CHAR(m.BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, m.ZIP, m.ADDR1, m.ADDR2, m.RECEIVE_EMAIL, m.SNS_PROVIDER, m.SNS_ID, m.CREATED_AT, m.UPDATED_AT FROM MEMBER m INNER JOIN APP_ROLE r ON m.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE m.LOGIN_ID = #{login_id}
SELECT r.ROLE_CODE AS authority FROM MEMBER m INNER JOIN APP_ROLE r ON m.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE m.LOGIN_ID = #{login_id}

SELECT m.MEMBER_ID, m.ROLE_ID, r.ROLE_CODE AS authority, r.ROLE_NAME, m.LOGIN_ID, m.PASSWORD_HASH AS password, m.NAME, m.EMAIL, m.PHONE AS tel, m.PROFILE_URL AS profile_photo, m.STATUS AS enabled, m.FAILURE_CNT, m.LAST_LOGIN_AT AS last_login, m.SNS_PROVIDER, m.SNS_ID, m.CREATED_AT, m.UPDATED_AT FROM MEMBER m INNER JOIN APP_ROLE r ON m.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE m.SNS_PROVIDER = #{sns_provider} AND m.SNS_ID = #{sns_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, ROLE_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD_HASH, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, PROFILE_URL, STATUS, FAILURE_CNT, BIRTH, ZIP, ADDR1, ADDR2, RECEIVE_EMAIL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{role_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{login_id}, #{password}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email}, #{tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profile_photo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 0, TO_DATE(#{birth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{zip, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{receive_email}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, ROLE_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD_HASH, NAME, EMAIL, PROFILE_URL, STATUS, FAILURE_CNT, SNS_PROVIDER, SNS_ID, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{role_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sns_provider} || '_' || #{sns_id}, -- 소셜 가입 시 임시 LOGIN_ID 생성 'SNS_USER', #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profile_photo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 0, #{sns_provider}, #{sns_id}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET PASSWORD_HASH = #{password}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{login_id}
UPDATE MEMBER SET PROFILE_URL = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}
